vetSays.line: 🛡️ Colin, the man in his 40s, Raj, Meera and the woman in her 20s met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Colin, the man in his 40s, Raj, Meera, the woman in her 20s are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Raj — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Raj chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🛡️ Kurt, Raj, Jorge, Ingrid and Aria met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Kurt, Raj, Jorge, Ingrid, Aria are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Kurt, Colin, Leo, Raj and Carlos met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Kurt, Colin, Raj are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lulwa just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Choir Toad!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carlos just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Colin just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Leo, Raj, Jorge, Ingrid and Aria met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Raj, Jorge, Ingrid are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Raj Patel, 50 — a Pharmacist. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded.

regDeaths.name: a line of ducks, walking in perfect formation. In the dark. That is not normal duck behavior.

stripes flowing where no wind blows
a gold flash in the grass, gone when you look
